name: LanguageSwitcher
description: Links to the same page in the site's other languages, each with hreflang and its own lang; the current one is marked aria-current. A plain list or a native <details> menu; no JavaScript. The addresses are the page's equivalents in each language, supplied by the caller.

layout.description: A row of links, or a menu that shows the current language and opens on click.

align.description: Which edge the menu panel lines up with.

labelStyle.description: The language's own name ("Deutsch") or its code ("DE").

languages.description: The languages: BCP 47 code, the language's own name, the page's address in it, and whether it is the page being read.

a11y: List layout: a labelled <nav>; menu layout: a native <details> whose summary carries the label for assistive technology and the current language visibly. Every link has lang and hreflang, so screen readers pronounce each name in its language; the current one is aria-current=true. Fewer than two languages draw nothing.
